items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I had one brother. His name was Robert. He was two years older than I was

ctx.x: Did you say you have brothers and sisters?

I had one brother. His name was Robert. He was two years older than I was, and we were known throughout Texas as the Price Boys. Not like the Daltons, or the Jesse James Boys; we were the Price Boys, and we were quite well known at first because/my father was a baker, you know, in Waco, and a lot of people used to come to him because he used to sell bread in our home, you see...a lot of people used to come. Then my grandfather, was a well-known A.M.E. minister, going from town to town each year, to build a new…

into a town where the conditions were deplorable and inadequate facilities for the church/ meeting; he'd take his fourteen kids and build a new church. Quite naturally that everybody wanted. So finally he asked the presiding elder why it is that he was always moved. "Well (said the elder), can't you see the handwriting on the wall? When you go into a church, and go into a new city and build a church/ everybody want you." So that was the history of doing quite a bit of traveling on his part for the first ten years…
